name: maliscope-platform
description: Financial literacy, market intelligence and offline learning platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @maliscope/api" "npm run dev -w @maliscope/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @maliscope/api && npm run build -w @maliscope/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @maliscope/api && npm run typecheck -w @maliscope/web
